text:
sarah_support: Customer reported several dashboard graphs showing "no data" and the page hanging. They pasted the console error: 

GET https://analytics.redwood.example/api/v1/metrics/query -> 504
x-request-id: 6f8b2c11-9a4d-4f1f-b7e2

Link: https://console.redwood.example/d/abc123/metrics-overview?orgId=5

mike_client_success: Customer: AcmePayments, high severity. They say the graphs have been blank for ~25m and they can't get their executive report. Can we confirm impact? :eyes:

raj_infra: On it. Can you paste the full curl you used or logs with the x-request-id? I want the request payload/params.

sarah_support: Pasted curl from browser repro (sanitized):
```
curl 'https://analytics.redwood.example/api/v1/metrics/query' \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  --data-raw '{"query":"SELECT sum(tokens) FROM metrics WHERE service=\"console\" AND time > now() - 1h"}' \
  -v
```
Response: HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
Body: {"error":"query timeout","query_id":"q_2026_03_04_1234"}

analytics-bot: [ALERT] analytics-aggregator latency spike: 15:42 UTC, 500+ errors across frontends (alert id: A-4421).

raj_infra: I see a flood of ClickHouse timeouts in the aggregator logs starting 15:36 UTC. Sample: `ClickHouseException: Code: 60, e.displayText() = DB::Exception: Timeout exceeded while reading from socket` with query_id q_2026_03_04_1234. Likely slow disk / hot partition or a bad aggregation.

elena_prod: We just merged an optimization for long-range rollup queries ~15:30 UTC in the analytics-aggregator service (PR #542). Rolling that back now to see if errors abate. Will update in 2-3m.

sydney_oncall: Escalating to eng-sre. Also suggest a temporary mitigation: force dashboards to use the metrics-read-fallback host `analytics-standby.redwood.example` by setting header `X-Analytics-Route: standby` via the console proxy. Can support team instruct the customer to switch to the cached-dashboard URL?

mike_client_success: I asked AcmePayments to try the cached dashboard link; they confirmed charts rendered (stale data) at 15:50 UTC. They prefer correctness over recency for the exec report.

raj_infra: After rollback to commit 4c9f7a1 the error rate dropped ~95% within 3m, ClickHouse queries returned to normal p95. Monitoring shows residual errors from longer running queries only.

elena_prod: Confirmed rollback applied to all aggregator instances. Root cause appears to be an unintended GROUP BY rewrite in the new optimizer that explodes intermediate partitions for multi-tenant rollups. We're opening a follow-up bug and will revert the optimizer until we have stricter limits.

sarah_support: Noted. Logged incident INC-2026-213, created a postmortem ticket ENG-2891. I told the customer the issue has been mitigated and to re-open if they see further problems.

sydney_oncall: Adding mitigation steps for runbook: 1) Watch for aggregated query timeouts on aggregator (error rate > 3%); 2) Roll back PR if errors spike after deploy; 3) If rollback unavailable, route traffic to `analytics-standby` and enable cached dashboards.

mike_client_success: Customer follow-up: they accepted stale/cached workaround for the exec report and asked for a brief RCA and ETA for a permanent fix. I'll send them the incident link and ETA once engineering provides it.

elena_prod: ETA for full fix (proper optimizer guardrails + tests): 3 business days. I'll assign ENG-2891 and link PRs.

sarah_support: Closing thread for now. I'll update when ENG posts the postmortem. :white_check_mark:
